notes: CDER CGMP letter for an oral-dosage-form manufacturer in India: inadequate complaint/deviation investigations (crumbling/pitted tablets), and confirmed API cross-contamination residues on nondedicated equipment plus inadequate cleaning validation/procedures (21 CFR 211.192, 211.67(a)-(b)). No sterile/aseptic processing is discussed; contamination_present is true because analytical testing confirmed actual API residue cross-contamination on equipment, not merely a hypothetical risk. All specific drug names are redacted as (b)(4) throughout. location_contains uses 'Medchal-Malkajgiri', the last place-name segment in the inspection sentence, since no city/state pairing is given there (the corporate Hyderabad/Telangana address is a mailing address, not the inspected site). Firm voluntarily suspended manufacturing at the facility; no product recall is mentioned, so recall_concern is false.
